subject: net
title: Routing tables
procedure: Building routing tables and applying longest prefix match
promptTemplate: Describe a small topology (routers, networks, interfaces) in text. easy: 2 routers, table for one router. medium: 3 routers with a default route. exam: aggregating possible routes and mapping destination addresses by longest prefix match. When checking: row by row destination, prefix, next hop, interface.

drills.explanation: Three prefixes match; the longest one, 10.1.2.0/24, wins.
10.1.0.0/16 is the longest matching prefix; 10.1.2.0/24 does not match.

drills.prompt: Aggregate `192.168.4.0/24` and `192.168.5.0/24` into a single prefix.
drills.explanation: 4 = 00000100 and 5 = 00000101 differ only in the last bit of the third byte, so 23 bits are shared.
